channel.title: astro-ph.GA updates on arXiv.org
channel.description: astro-ph.GA updates on the arXiv.org e-print archive.

item.title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1): Disc breaks highlight the structural evolution of galaxies through time
item.description: arXiv:2609.26877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Changes in the slope of the radial surface brightness profiles of disc galaxies, or disc breaks, encode valuable information about the processes driving disc formation and growth.
item.dc:creator: Euclid Collaboration, P. M. Sanchez-Alarcon

item.title: The birth and fate of stellar clumps in super-early galaxies
item.description: arXiv:2609.26993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: (Abridged) JWST has revealed extremely compact stellar clumps in galaxies at z>6, but their formation mechanism and subsequent evolution remain uncertain.
item.dc:creator: A. Test Author

item.title: In-Situ Star Formation in a Thick Disk: A Model for Metal Enrichment of Mrk 573
item.description: arXiv:2609.27048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent observations of the nearby Seyfert galaxy Mrk 573 found that the galactic nucleus and bicone regions surrounding the jet are significantly metal-enriched.
item.dc:creator: B. Test Author

item.title: Project Dinos II: Redshift evolution of dark and luminous matter density profiles in strong-lensing elliptical galaxies across 0.1 < z < 0.9
item.description: arXiv:2408.10316v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a new measurement of the dark and luminous matter distribution of massive elliptical galaxies, and their evolution with redshift, by combining strong lensing and dynamical observables.
item.dc:creator: C. Test Author

item.title: TDCOSMO XXV: Measuring H0 to 6.5% precision with quasar strong lensing and maximally flexible mass-sheet dynamics
item.description: arXiv:2604.14145v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a blind time-delay cosmography measurement of the Hubble-Lema\^itre constant $H_0$ based on the quadruply imaged quasar SDSSJ1433+6007.
item.dc:creator: D. Test Author
